title: Overcoming strength-ductility tradeoff with high pressure thermal treatment
summary_zh: 本文研究高压热处理克服强度延展性权衡。通过高压热处理使合金强度和延展性同时提高。实验表明形成有序微观结构促进多尺度变形机制。
summary_en: This paper studies overcoming the strength-ductility tradeoff with high-pressure thermal treatment. High-pressure thermal treatment simultaneously enhances strength and ductility of alloys. Experiments show the formation of an orderly microstructure promotes multiple deformation mechanisms at multiple scales.
insights: 创新点：高压热处理实现强度延展性协同提升
方法亮点：形成有序微观结构
关键发现：多尺度变形机制促进
insights_en: Novelty: High-pressure thermal treatment achieves strength-ductility synergy
Method highlight: Orderly microstructure formation
Key finding: Multiple deformation mechanisms promoted
abstract: Conventional material processing approaches often achieve strengthening of materials at the cost of reduced ductility. Here, we show that high-pressure and high-temperature (HPHT) treatment can help overcome the strength-ductility trade-off in structural materials. We report an initially strong-yet-brittle eutectic high entropy alloy simultaneously doubling its strength to 1150 MPa and its tensile ductility to 36% after the HPHT treatment. Such strength-ductility synergy is attributed to the HPHT-induced formation of a hierarchically patterned microstructure with coherent interfaces, which promotes multiple deformation mechanisms, including dislocations, stacking faults, microbands and deformation twins, at multiple length scales. More importantly, the HPHT-induced microstructure helps relieve stress concentration at the interfaces, thereby arresting interfacial cracking commonly observed in traditional eutectic high entropy alloys. These findings suggest a new direction of research in employing HPHT techniques to help develop next generation structural materials.

title: The roll-to-roll revolution to tackle the industrial leap for perovskite solar cells
summary_zh: 本文研究卷对卷技术助力钙钛矿太阳能电池工业化。卷对卷技术提高产量、降低成本、适应柔性基板。强调持续创新以充分利用该技术。
summary_en: This paper studies the use of roll-to-roll technology for the industrialization of perovskite solar cells. Roll-to-roll technology enhances throughput, reduces costs, and accommodates flexible substrates. It emphasizes the need for ongoing innovation to fully utilize this technology.
insights: 创新点：卷对卷技术推动钙钛矿太阳能电池工业化
方法亮点：提高产量和降低成本
关键发现：持续创新至关重要
insights_en: Novelty: Roll-to-roll technology drives perovskite solar cell industrialization
Method highlight: Increased throughput and reduced costs
Key finding: Ongoing innovation is crucial
abstract: Can Roll-to-Roll technology pave the way for perovskite devices to transition from lab-scale to industrial applications? It is a technique that has the potential to enhance throughput, reduce costs, and accommodate flexible substrates. In a Roll-to-Roll system, as long as your input materials are continuously topped up, manufacture should continue indefinitely. In its simplest form it offers the premise of Ink-IN / Solar module-OUT. Through this comment, we emphasize the critical need for ongoing innovation to fully harness Roll-to-Roll technology’s capabilities, making perovskite solar energy a viable, sustainable option on a global scale. Roll-to-Roll (R2R) coating is a technology that potentially enhances throughput, reduces costs, and accommodates flexible substrates for fabricating various types of solar cells and modules. Here, authors discuss the R2R revolution to tackle the industrial leap for perovskite photovoltaic devices.

title: Monosymmetric Fe-N4 sites enabling durable proton exchange membrane fuel cell cathode by chemical vapor modification
summary_zh: 本文研究化学气相改性提高质子交换膜燃料电池耐久性。通过改性改变活性位点结构，增强碳基体石墨化程度。实验表明改性催化剂耐久性优异。
summary_en: This paper studies enhancing the durability of proton exchange membrane fuel cell cathodes by chemical vapor modification. Modification alters the active site structure and enhances the degree of graphitization in the carbon substrate. Experiments show the modified catalyst exhibits excellent durability.
insights: 创新点：化学气相改性提高耐久性
方法亮点：改变活性位点结构
关键发现：改性催化剂耐久性优异
insights_en: Novelty: Chemical vapor modification enhances durability
Method highlight: Alteration of active site structure
Key finding: Excellent durability of modified catalyst
abstract: The limited durability of metal-nitrogen-carbon electrocatalysts severely restricts their applicability for the oxygen reduction reaction in proton exchange membrane fuel cells. In this study, we employ the chemical vapor modification method to alter the configuration of active sites from FeN<sub>4</sub> to the stable monosymmetric FeN<sub>2</sub>+N'<sub>2</sub>, along with enhancing the degree of graphitization in the carbon substrate. This improvement effectively addresses the challenges associated with Fe active center leaching caused by N-group protonation and free radicals attack due to the 2-electron oxygen reduction reaction. The electrocatalyst with neoteric active site exhibited excellent durability. During accelerated aging test, the electrocatalyst exhibited negligible decline in its half-wave potential even after undergoing 200,000 potential cycles. Furthermore, when subjected to operational conditions representative of fuel cell systems, the electrocatalyst displayed remarkable durability, sustaining stable performance for a duration exceeding 248 h. The significant improvement in durability provides highly valuable insights for the practical application of metal-nitrogen-carbon electrocatalysts.

title: An integrated spatio-temporal view of riverine biodiversity using environmental DNA metabarcoding
summary_zh: 本文研究利用环境DNA宏条形码分析河流生物多样性。通过密集时空采样，分析不同河流、时间和环境条件下的生物多样性。
summary_en: This paper studies riverine biodiversity using environmental DNA metabarcoding. Through intensive spatio-temporal sampling, it analyzes biodiversity across different rivers, time points, and environmental conditions.
insights: 创新点：环境DNA宏条形码分析河流生物多样性
方法亮点：密集时空采样
关键发现：不同时空尺度下的生物多样性
insights_en: Novelty: Environmental DNA metabarcoding for riverine biodiversity analysis
Method highlight: Intensive spatio-temporal sampling
Key finding: Biodiversity across different spatio-temporal scales
abstract: Anthropogenically forced changes in global freshwater biodiversity demand more efficient monitoring approaches. Consequently, environmental DNA (eDNA) analysis is enabling ecosystem-scale biodiversity assessment, yet the appropriate spatio-temporal resolution of robust biodiversity assessment remains ambiguous. Here, using intensive, spatio-temporal eDNA sampling across space (five rivers in Europe and North America, with an upper range of 20-35 km between samples), time (19 timepoints between 2017 and 2018) and environmental conditions (river flow, pH, conductivity, temperature and rainfall), we characterise the resolution at which information on diversity across the animal kingdom can be gathered from rivers using eDNA. In space, beta diversity was mainly dictated by turnover, on a scale of tens of kilometres, highlighting that diversity measures are not confounded by eDNA from upstream. Fish communities showed nested assemblages along some rivers, coinciding with habitat use. Across time, seasonal life history events, including salmon and eel migration, were detected. Finally, effects of environmental conditions were taxon-specific, reflecting habitat filtering of communities rather than effects on DNA molecules. We conclude that riverine eDNA metabarcoding can measure biodiversity at spatio-temporal scales relevant to species and community ecology, demonstrating its utility in delivering insights into river community ecology during a time of environmental change.

title: Single-zinc vacancy unlocks high-rate H2O2 electrosynthesis from mixed dioxygen beyond Le Chatelier principle
summary_zh: 本文研究单锌空位突破混合氧气中H2O2电合成速率限制。通过单锌空位实现催化剂与氧气的高选择性结合，改变反应路径。
summary_en: This paper studies unlocking high-rate H2O2 electrosynthesis from mixed dioxygen using single-zinc vacancies. Single-zinc vacancies enable the catalyst to bind with oxygen with high selectivity, altering the reaction pathway.
insights: 创新点：单锌空位突破速率限制
方法亮点：提高氧气选择性结合
关键发现：改变反应路径
insights_en: Novelty: Single-zinc vacancy breaks rate limitation
Method highlight: Enhanced oxygen selectivity binding
Key finding: Reaction pathway alteration
abstract: Le Chatelier's principle is a basic rule in textbook defining the correlations of reaction activities and specific system parameters (like concentrations), serving as the guideline for regulating chemical/catalytic systems. Here we report a model system breaking this constraint in O<sub>2</sub> electroreduction in mixed dioxygen. We unravel the central role of creating single-zinc vacancies in a crystal structure that leads to enzyme-like binding of the catalyst with enhanced selectivity to O<sub>2</sub>, shifting the reaction pathway from Langmuir-Hinshelwood to an upgraded triple-phase Eley-Rideal mechanism. The model system shows minute activity alteration of H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub> yields (25.89~24.99 mol g<sub>cat</sub><sup>-1</sup> h<sup>-1</sup>) and Faradaic efficiencies (92.5%~89.3%) in the O<sub>2</sub> levels of 100%~21% at the current density of 50~300 mA cm<sup>-2</sup>, which apparently violate macroscopic Le Chatelier's reaction kinetics. A standalone prototype device is built for high-rate H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub> production from atmospheric air, achieving the highest Faradaic efficiencies of 87.8% at 320 mA cm<sup>-2</sup>, overtaking the state-of-the-art catalysts and approaching the theoretical limit for direct air electrolysis (~345.8 mA cm<sup>-2</sup>). Further techno-economics analyses display the use of atmospheric air feedstock affording 21.7% better economics as comparison to high-purity O<sub>2</sub>, achieving the lowest H<sub>2</sub>O<sub>2</sub> capital cost of 0.3 $ Kg<sup>-1</sup>. Given the recent surge of demonstrations on tailoring chemical/catalytic systems based on the Le Chatelier's principle, the present finding would have general implications, allowing for leveraging systems "beyond" this classical rule.

title: The “4 + 1” strategy fabrication of iron single-atom catalysts with selective high-valent iron-oxo species generation
summary_zh: 研究提出了一种制备铁单原子催化剂的新策略。通过“4+1”策略，实现高选择性生成高价铁-氧物种。
summary_en: This study proposes a new strategy for the fabrication of iron single-atom catalysts. The '4+1' strategy achieves highly selective formation of high-valent iron-oxo species.
insights: “4+1”策略有效提高了铁单原子催化剂的选择性
研究揭示了高价铁-氧物种在催化剂中的作用
新策略为水净化中的Fenton-like反应提供了新的思路
insights_en: The '4+1' strategy effectively enhances the selectivity of iron single-atom catalysts
The study reveals the role of high-valent iron-oxo species in the catalyst
The new strategy offers new insights for Fenton-like reactions in water purification
abstract: Single-atom catalysts (SACs) with atomic dispersion active sites have exhibited huge potentials in peroxymonosulfate (PMS)-based Fenton-like chemistry in water purification. However, four-N coordination metal (MN<sub>4</sub>) moieties often suffer from such problems as low selectivity and narrow workable pH. How to construct SACs in a controllable strategy with optimized electronic structures is of great challenge. Herein, an innovative strategy (i.e., the "4 + 1" fabrication) was devised to precisely modulate the first-shell coordinated microenvironment of FeN<sub>4</sub> SAC using an additional N (SA-FeN<sub>5</sub>). This leads to almost 100% selective formation of high-valent iron-oxo [Fe(IV)═O] (steady-state concentration: 2.00 × 10<sup>-8</sup> M) in the SA-FeN<sub>5</sub>/PMS system. In-depth theoretical calculations unveil that FeN<sub>5</sub> configuration optimizes the electron distribution of monatomic Fe sites, which thus fosters PMS adsorption and reduces the energy barrier for Fe(IV)═O generation. SA-FeN<sub>5</sub> was then attached to polyvinylidene difluoride membrane for a continuous flow device, showing long-term abatement of the microcontaminant. This work furnishes a general strategy for effective PMS activation and selective high-valent metal-oxo species generation by high N-coordination number regulation in SACs, which would provide guidance in the rational design of superior environmental catalysts for water purification.

title: An ultrawide field-of-view pinhole compound eye using hemispherical nanowire array for robot vision
summary_zh: 提出一种基于半球形纳米线阵列的超广视场针孔复合眼，用于机器人视觉。结合三维打印光学结构和固态高密度钙钛矿纳米线光电探测器。
summary_en: This paper proposes an ultrawide field-of-view pinhole compound eye using a hemispherical nanowire array for robot vision. Combines a 3D-printed optical structure with a solid-state, high-density perovskite nanowire photodetector array.
insights: 创新点：超广视场针孔复合眼
方法亮点：半球形纳米线阵列
关键发现：机器人视觉应用
insights_en: Novelty: Ultrawide field-of-view pinhole compound eye
Method highlight: Hemispherical nanowire array
Key finding: Application in robot vision
abstract: Garnering inspiration from biological compound eyes, artificial vision systems boasting a vivid range of diverse visual functional traits have come to the fore recently. However, most of these artificial systems rely on transformable electronics, which suffer from the complexity and constrained geometry of global deformation, as well as potential mismatches between optical and detector units. Here, we present a unique pinhole compound eye that combines a three-dimensionally printed honeycomb optical structure with a hemispherical, all-solid-state, high-density perovskite nanowire photodetector array. The lens-free pinhole structure can be designed and fabricated with an arbitrary layout to match the underlying image sensor. Optical simulations and imaging results matched well with each other and substantiated the key characteristics and capabilities of our system, which include an ultrawide field of view, accurate target positioning, and motion tracking function. We further demonstrate the potential of our unique compound eye for advanced robotic vision by successfully completing a moving target tracking mission.

title: An ultrawide field-of-view pinhole compound eye using hemispherical nanowire array for robot vision
summary_zh: 本文提出一种新型微孔复合眼，结合三维打印蜂窝光学结构和半球形钙钛矿纳米线光电探测器阵列。光学模拟和成像结果与预期相符。实验表明，该系统具有广阔的视野和优异的成像性能。
summary_en: This paper proposes a novel pinhole compound eye that combines a 3D-printed honeycomb optical structure with a hemispherical perovskite nanowire photodetector array. Optical simulations and imaging results are consistent with expectations. Experiments demonstrate that the system has a wide field of view and excellent imaging performance.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种新型微孔复合眼结构
方法亮点：结合了三维打印和钙钛矿纳米线技术
关键发现：实现了广阔视野和优异成像性能
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a novel pinhole compound eye structure
Method highlight: Combined 3D printing and perovskite nanowire technology
Key finding: Achieved wide field of view and excellent imaging performance
abstract: Garnering inspiration from biological compound eyes, artificial vision systems boasting a vivid range of diverse visual functional traits have come to the fore recently. However, most of these artificial systems rely on transformable electronics, which suffer from the complexity and constrained geometry of global deformation, as well as potential mismatches between optical and detector units. Here, we present a unique pinhole compound eye that combines a three-dimensionally printed honeycomb optical structure with a hemispherical, all-solid-state, high-density perovskite nanowire photodetector array. The lens-free pinhole structure can be designed and fabricated with an arbitrary layout to match the underlying image sensor. Optical simulations and imaging results matched well with each other and substantiated the key characteristics and capabilities of our system, which include an ultrawide field of view, accurate target positioning, and motion tracking function. We further demonstrate the potential of our unique compound eye for advanced robotic vision by successfully completing a moving target tracking mission.

title: Evolvability predicts macroevolution under fluctuating selection
summary_zh: 研究化石和现生生物数据，发现种群间进化差异随微进化可塑性增加。评估假设，提出遗传约束影响种群追踪环境波动的能力。
summary_en: Using fossil and contemporary datasets, the study finds that evolutionary divergence among populations increases with microevolutionary evolvability. Evaluating hypotheses, it proposes that genetic constraints influence populations' ability to track environmental fluctuations.
insights: 进化可塑性预测宏观进化趋势
遗传约束影响种群追踪环境波动
研究揭示种群间进化差异与微进化可塑性的关系
insights_en: Evolvability predicts macroevolutionary trends
Genetic constraints influence population tracking of environmental fluctuations
Research reveals the relationship between population divergence and microevolutionary evolvability
abstract: Heritable variation is a prerequisite for evolutionary change, but the relevance of genetic constraints on macroevolutionary timescales is debated. By using two datasets on fossil and contemporary taxa, we show that evolutionary divergence among populations, and to a lesser extent among species, increases with microevolutionary evolvability. We evaluate and reject several hypotheses to explain this relationship and propose that an effect of evolvability on population and species divergence can be explained by the influence of genetic constraints on the ability of populations to track rapid, stationary environmental fluctuations.

title: Molecular templating of layered halide perovskite nanowires
summary_zh: 提出分子模板法，限制晶体生长方向，合成高质量层状钙钛矿纳米线。纳米线具有优异的光学性质和可调化学组成。
summary_en: A molecular templating method is proposed to restrict crystal growth directions, synthesizing high-quality layered perovskite nanowires with exceptional optical properties and tunable chemical compositions.
insights: 分子模板法合成层状钙钛矿纳米线
纳米线具有优异的光学性质
可调化学组成提供广泛应用
insights_en: Molecular templating for synthesizing layered perovskite nanowires
Nanowires exhibit exceptional optical properties
Tunable chemical composition for wide applications
abstract: Layered metal-halide perovskites, or two-dimensional perovskites, can be synthesized in solution, and their optical and electronic properties can be tuned by changing their composition. We report a molecular templating method that restricted crystal growth along all crystallographic directions except for [110] and promoted one-dimensional growth. Our approach is widely applicable to synthesize a range of high-quality layered perovskite nanowires with large aspect ratios and tunable organic-inorganic chemical compositions. These nanowires form exceptionally well-defined and flexible cavities that exhibited a wide range of unusual optical properties beyond those of conventional perovskite nanowires. We observed anisotropic emission polarization, low-loss waveguiding (below 3 decibels per millimeter), and efficient low-threshold light amplification (below 20 microjoules per square centimeter).

title: Spontaneous weathering of natural minerals in charged water microdroplets forms nanomaterials
summary_zh: 矿物颗粒在带电水微滴中自发分解成纳米颗粒。电喷雾生成微滴，沉积后进行纳米颗粒表征。
summary_en: Mineral particles spontaneously break down into nanoparticles in charged water microdroplets. Microdroplets generated via electrospray are deposited and characterized for nanoparticles.
insights: 带电水微滴中矿物自发分解
电喷雾技术生成微滴
纳米颗粒表征揭示快速风化过程
insights_en: Spontaneous decomposition of minerals in charged water microdroplets
Electrospray technique for generating microdroplets
Nanoparticle characterization reveals rapid weathering process
abstract: In this work, we show that particles of common minerals break down spontaneously to form nanoparticles in charged water microdroplets within milliseconds. We transformed micron-sized natural minerals like quartz and ruby into 5- to 10-nanometer particles when integrated into aqueous microdroplets generated via electrospray. We deposited the droplets on a substrate, which allowed nanoparticle characterization. We determined through simulations that quartz undergoes proton-induced slip, especially when reduced in size and exposed to an electric field. This leads to particle scission and the formation of silicate fragments, which we confirmed with mass spectrometry. This rapid weathering process may be important for soil formation, given the prevalence of charged aerosols in the atmosphere.

title: Waveguide-integrated twisted bilayer graphene photodetectors
summary_zh: 实现硅光子集成扭曲双层石墨烯探测器，提高光电响应性，实现高带宽和数据流率。
summary_en: Realizes SiPh-integrated twisted bilayer graphene photodetectors, enhancing photoresponsivity and achieving high bandwidth and data stream rate.
insights: 创新点：实现硅光子集成扭曲双层石墨烯探测器
方法亮点：提高光电响应性
关键发现：实现高带宽和数据流率
insights_en: Novelty: Realizing SiPh-integrated twisted bilayer graphene photodetectors
Method highlight: Enhancing photoresponsivity
Key finding: Achieving high bandwidth and data stream rate
abstract: Graphene photodetectors have exhibited high bandwidth and capability of being integrated with silicon photonics (SiPh), holding promise for future optical communication devices. However, they usually suffer from a low photoresponsivity due to weak optical absorption. In this work, we have implemented SiPh-integrated twisted bilayer graphene (tBLG) detectors and reported a responsivity of 0.65 A W<sup>-1</sup> for telecom wavelength 1,550 nm. The high responsivity enables a 3-dB bandwidth of >65 GHz and a high data stream rate of 50 Gbit s<sup>-1</sup>. Such high responsivity is attributed to the enhanced optical absorption, which is facilitated by van Hove singularities in the band structure of high-mobility tBLG with 4.1<sup>o</sup> twist angle. The uniform performance of the fabricated photodetector arrays demonstrates a fascinating prospect of large-area tBLG as a material candidate for heterogeneous integration with SiPh.

title: Automatic detection of methane emissions in multispectral satellite imagery using a vision transformer
summary_zh: 使用视觉Transformer在多光谱卫星图像中自动检测甲烷排放，实现全球覆盖和高时空分辨率。
summary_en: Automatically detects methane emissions in multispectral satellite imagery using a vision transformer, achieving global coverage and high temporal and spatial resolution.
insights: 创新点：使用视觉Transformer检测甲烷排放
方法亮点：实现全球覆盖和高时空分辨率
关键发现：提高检测精度
insights_en: Novelty: Using a vision transformer to detect methane emissions
Method highlight: Achieving global coverage and high temporal and spatial resolution
Key finding: Improving detection accuracy
abstract: Curbing methane emissions is among the most effective actions that can be taken to slow down global warming. However, monitoring emissions remains challenging, as detection methods have a limited quantification completeness due to trade-offs that have to be made between coverage, resolution, and detection accuracy. Here we show that deep learning can overcome the trade-off in terms of spectral resolution that comes with multi-spectral satellite data, resulting in a methane detection tool with global coverage and high temporal and spatial resolution. We compare our detections with airborne methane measurement campaigns, which suggests that our method can detect methane point sources in Sentinel-2 data down to plumes of 0.01 km<sup>2</sup>, corresponding to 200 to 300 kg CH<sub>4</sub> h<sup>-1</sup> sources. Our model shows an order of magnitude improvement over the state-of-the-art, providing a significant step towards the automated, high resolution detection of methane emissions at a global scale, every few days.

title: Redox-induced controllable engineering of MnO2-MnxCo3-xO4 interface to boost catalytic oxidation of ethane
summary_zh: 研究通过化学还原设计MnCoOx催化剂，形成MnO2-MnxCo3-xO4界面，提升乙烷氧化催化活性。实验表明，Mn/Co比为0.5的催化剂在潮湿条件下表现出优异的活性和稳定性。
summary_en: This study designs MnCoOx catalysts through chemical reduction to form MnO2-MnxCo3-xO4 interfaces, enhancing ethane oxidation catalytic activity. Experiments show that the catalyst with a Mn/Co ratio of 0.5 exhibits excellent activity and stability under humid conditions.
insights: 创新点：通过界面工程提升催化活性
方法亮点：化学还原制备MnCoOx催化剂
关键发现：Mn/Co比为0.5的催化剂具有优异性能
insights_en: Novelty: Interface engineering enhances catalytic activity
Method highlight: Chemical reduction for MnCoOx catalyst preparation
Key finding: Catalyst with Mn/Co ratio of 0.5 exhibits superior performance
abstract: Multicomponent oxides are intriguing materials in heterogeneous catalysis, and the interface between various components often plays an essential role in oxidations. However, the underlying principles of how the hetero-interface affects the catalytic process remain largely unexplored. Here we report a unique structure design of MnCoO<sub>x</sub> catalysts by chemical reduction, specifically for ethane oxidation. Part of the Mn ions incorporates with Co oxides to form spinel Mn<sub>x</sub>Co<sub>3-x</sub>O<sub>4</sub>, while the rests stay as MnO<sub>2</sub> domains to create the MnO<sub>2</sub>-Mn<sub>x</sub>Co<sub>3-x</sub>O<sub>4</sub> interface. MnCoO<sub>x</sub> with Mn/Co ratio of 0.5 exhibits an excellent activity and stability up to 1000 h under humid conditions. The synergistic effects between MnO<sub>2</sub> and Mn<sub>x</sub>Co<sub>3-x</sub>O<sub>4</sub> are elucidated, in which the C<sub>2</sub>H<sub>6</sub> tends to be adsorbed on the interfacial Co sites and subsequently break the C-H bonds on the reactive lattice O of MnO<sub>2</sub> layer. Findings from this study provide valuable insights for the rational design of efficient catalysts for alkane combustion.

title: Sustainable thermal regulation improves stability and efficiency in all-perovskite tandem solar cells
summary_zh: 研究通过在钙钛矿中引入碳硼烷提高热导率，改善热管理，提升钙钛矿太阳能电池的稳定性和效率。实验发现，正碳硼烷在钙钛矿层中存在，并表现出良好的热导性能。
summary_en: This study incorporates carboranes into perovskites to enhance thermal conductivity and improve thermal management, thus increasing the stability and efficiency of perovskite tandem solar cells. Experiments show the presence of ortho-carborane in the perovskite layer with good thermal conductivity.
insights: 创新点：引入碳硼烷改善热管理
方法亮点：正碳硼烷用于提升热导率
关键发现：正碳硼烷在钙钛矿层中存在
insights_en: Novelty: Incorporating carboranes to improve thermal management
Method highlight: Ortho-carborane for enhancing thermal conductivity
Key finding: Ortho-carborane exists in the perovskite layer
abstract: Mixed Sn-Pb perovskites have emerged as promising photovoltaic materials for both single- and multi-junction solar cells. However, achieving their scale-up and practical application requires further enhancement in stability. We identify that their poor thermal conductivity results in insufficient thermal transfer, leading to heat accumulation within the absorber layer that accelerates thermal degradation. A thermal regulation strategy by incorporating carboranes into perovskites is developed; these are electron-delocalized carbon-boron molecules known for their efficient heat transfer capability. We specifically select ortho-carborane due to its low thermal hysteresis. We observe its existence through the perovskite layer showing a decreasing trend from the buried interface to the top surface, effectively transferring heat and lowering the surface temperature by around 5 °C under illumination. o-CB also facilitates hole extraction at the perovskite/PEDOT:PSS interface and reduces charge recombination. These enable mixed Sn-Pb cells to exhibit improved thermal stability, retaining 80% of their initial efficiencies after aging at 85 °C for 1080 hours. When integrated into monolithic all-perovskite tandems, we achieve efficiencies of over 27%. A tandem cell maintains 87% of its initial PCE after 704 h of continuous operation under illumination.

title: Supramolecular metallic foams with ultrahigh specific strength and sustainable recyclability
summary_zh: 研究开发了一种超分子金属泡沫，通过核心壳纳米结构液体金属和金属配位氢键相互作用，实现超高比强度和可持续回收。实验结果表明，该泡沫的比强度和比模量远超传统泡沫材料。
summary_en: This study develops a supramolecular metallic foam with core-shell nanostructured liquid metals and metal-ligand coordination hydrogen bonding interactions, achieving ultrahigh specific strength and sustainable recyclability. Experimental results show that the foam's specific strength and modulus are significantly higher than those of traditional foam materials.
insights: 创新点：超分子金属泡沫的设计
方法亮点：核心壳纳米结构液体金属的应用
关键发现：比强度和比模量远超传统泡沫
insights_en: Novelty: Design of supramolecular metallic foam
Method highlight: Application of core-shell nanostructured liquid metals
Key finding: Specific strength and modulus significantly exceed those of traditional foams
abstract: Porous materials with ultrahigh specific strength are highly desirable for aerospace, automotive and construction applications. However, because of the harsh processing of metal foams and intrinsic low strength of polymer foams, both are difficult to meet the demand for scalable development of structural foams. Herein, we present a supramolecular metallic foam (SMF) enabled by core-shell nanostructured liquid metals connected with high-density metal-ligand coordination and hydrogen bonding interactions, which maintain fluid to avoid stress concentration during foam processing at subzero temperatures. The resulted SMFs exhibit ultrahigh specific strength of 489.68 kN m kg<sup>-1</sup> (about 5 times and 56 times higher than aluminum foams and polyurethane foams) and specific modulus of 281.23 kN m kg<sup>-1</sup> to withstand the repeated loading of a car, overturning the previous understanding of the difficulty to achieve ultrahigh mechanical properties in traditional polymeric or organic foams. More importantly, end-of-life SMFs can be reprocessed into value-added products (e.g., fibers and films) by facile water reprocessing due to the high-density interfacial supramolecular bonding. We envisage this work will not only pave the way for porous structural materials design but also show the sustainable solution to plastic environmental risks.

title: Wood-inspired anisotropic hydrogel electrolyte with large modulus and low tortuosity realizing durable dendrite-free zinc-ion batteries
summary_zh: 研究提出新型木灵感电解质，解决锌离子电池枝晶问题。通过定向冻结和压缩强化，提高电解质模量。实验证明，该电解质显著抑制枝晶生长。
summary_en: This study proposes a novel wood-inspired anisotropic hydrogel electrolyte to address the dendrite issue in zinc-ion batteries. Through directional freezing and compression reinforcement, the modulus of the electrolyte is enhanced. Experiments demonstrate that this electrolyte significantly inhibits dendrite growth.
insights: 创新点：木灵感电解质设计抑制锌离子电池枝晶
方法亮点：定向冻结和压缩强化提高电解质模量
关键发现：电解质显著抑制枝晶生长
insights_en: Novelty: Wood-inspired electrolyte design inhibits dendrite growth in zinc-ion batteries
Method highlight: Directional freezing and compression reinforcement enhance electrolyte modulus
Key finding: The electrolyte significantly inhibits dendrite growth
abstract: While aqueous zinc-ion batteries exhibit great potential, their performance is impeded by zinc dendrites. Existing literature has proposed the use of hydrogel electrolytes to ameliorate this issue. Nevertheless, the mechanical attributes of hydrogel electrolytes, particularly their modulus, are suboptimal, primarily ascribed to the substantial water content. This drawback would severely restrict the dendrite-inhibiting efficacy, especially under large mass loadings of active materials. Inspired by the structural characteristics of wood, this study endeavors to fabricate the anisotropic carboxymethyl cellulose hydrogel electrolyte through directional freezing, salting-out effect, and compression reinforcement, aiming to maximize the modulus along the direction perpendicular to the electrode surface. The heightened modulus concurrently serves to suppress the vertical deposition of the intermediate product at the cathode. Meanwhile, the oriented channels with low tortuosity enabled by the anisotropic structure are beneficial to the ionic transport between the anode and cathode. Comparative analysis with an isotropic hydrogel sample reveals a marked enhancement in both modulus and ionic conductivity in the anisotropic hydrogel. This enhancement contributes to significantly improved zinc stripping/plating reversibility and mitigated electrochemical polarization. Additionally, a durable quasi-solid-state Zn//MnO<sub>2</sub> battery with noteworthy volumetric energy density is realized. This study offers unique perspectives for designing hydrogel electrolytes and augmenting battery performance.

title: TRANSIC: Sim-to-Real Policy Transfer by Learning from Online Correction
summary_zh: 提出基于在线校正的学习方法，实现模拟到现实的策略迁移。利用人类观察和协助，缩小模拟与现实差距。
summary_en: Proposes a method for sim-to-real policy transfer by learning from online correction. Utilizes human observation and assistance to narrow the gap between simulation and reality.
insights: 创新点：基于在线校正的学习方法
方法亮点：人类在环框架
关键发现：缩小模拟与现实差距
insights_en: Novelty: Learning method based on online correction
Method highlight: Human-in-the-loop framework
Key finding: Narrowing the gap between simulation and reality
abstract: Learning in simulation and transferring the learned policy to the real world has the potential to enable generalist robots. The key challenge of this approach is to address simulation-to-reality (sim-to-real) gaps. Previous methods often require domain-specific knowledge a priori. We argue that a straightforward way to obtain such knowledge is by asking humans to observe and assist robot policy execution in the real world. The robots can then learn from humans to close various sim-to-real gaps. We propose TRANSIC, a data-driven approach to enable successful sim-to-real transfer based on a human-in-the-loop framework. TRANSIC allows humans to augment simulation policies to overcome various unmodeled sim-to-real gaps holistically through intervention and online correction. Residual policies can be learned from human corrections and integrated with simulation policies for autonomous execution. We show that our approach can achieve successful sim-to-real transfer in complex and contact-rich manipulation tasks such as furniture assembly. Through synergistic integration of policies learned in simulation and from humans, TRANSIC is effective as a holistic approach to addressing various, often coexisting sim-to-real gaps. It displays attractive properties such as scaling with human effort. Videos and code are available at https://transic-robot.github.io/

title: Understanding the Asian water tower requires a redesigned precipitation observation strategy
summary_zh: 本文指出，为了更好地理解亚洲水塔，需要重新设计降水观测策略。
summary_en: This paper points out that to better understand the Asian water tower, a redesigned precipitation observation strategy is required.
insights: 创新点：揭示了亚洲水塔降水观测的不足
方法亮点：提出了重新设计观测策略的建议
关键发现：观测策略的改进将有助于理解水循环
insights_en: Novelty: Reveals the shortcomings of precipitation observation in the Asian water tower
Method highlight: Suggests redesigning the observation strategy
Key finding: Improving the observation strategy will help understand the water cycle
abstract: The Asian water tower (AWT) serves as the source of 10 major Asian river systems and supports the lives of ~2 billion people. Obtaining reliable precipitation data over the AWT is a prerequisite for understanding the water cycle within this pivotal region. Here, we quantitatively reveal that the "observed" precipitation over the AWT is considerably underestimated in view of observational evidence from three water cycle components, namely, evapotranspiration, runoff, and accumulated snow. We found that three paradoxes appear if the so-called observed precipitation is corrected, namely, actual evapotranspiration exceeding precipitation, unrealistically high runoff coefficients, and accumulated snow water equivalent exceeding contemporaneous precipitation. We then explain the cause of precipitation underestimation from instrumental error caused by wind-induced gauge undercatch and the representativeness error caused by sparse-uneven gauge density and the complexity of local surface conditions. These findings require us to rethink previous results concerning the water cycle, prompting the study to discuss potential solutions.

title: Surpassing millisecond coherence in on chip superconducting quantum memories by optimizing materials and circuit design
summary_zh: 通过优化材料和电路设计，实现芯片上超导量子存储器超越毫秒相干时间。采用多模式方法表征能量损失，预测器件性能，通过材料、工艺和电路设计优化提高相干性。
summary_en: Achieves coherence times beyond milliseconds in on-chip superconducting quantum memories through material and circuit design optimization. Utilizes a multimode approach to characterize energy losses, predict device performance, and improve coherence through material, process, and circuit design optimization.
insights: 创新点：采用多模式方法表征能量损失，优化超导量子存储器性能。
方法亮点：通过材料、工艺和电路设计优化，提高器件相干性。
关键发现：实现芯片上超导量子存储器超越毫秒相干时间。
insights_en: Novelty: Uses a multimode approach to characterize energy losses and optimize the performance of superconducting quantum memories.
Method highlight: Improves device coherence through material, process, and circuit design optimization.
Key finding: Achieves coherence times beyond milliseconds in on-chip superconducting quantum memories.
abstract: The performance of superconducting quantum circuits for quantum computing has advanced tremendously in recent decades; however, a comprehensive understanding of relaxation mechanisms does not yet exist. In this work, we utilize a multimode approach to characterizing energy losses in superconducting quantum circuits, with the goals of predicting device performance and improving coherence through materials, process, and circuit design optimization. Using this approach, we measure significant reductions in surface and bulk dielectric losses by employing a tantalum-based materials platform and annealed sapphire substrates. With this knowledge we predict the relaxation times of aluminum- and tantalum-based transmon qubits, and find that they are consistent with experimental results. We additionally optimize device geometry to maximize coherence within a coaxial tunnel architecture, and realize on-chip quantum memories with single-photon Ramsey times of 2.0 - 2.7 ms, limited by their energy relaxation times of 1.0 - 1.4 ms. These results demonstrate an advancement towards a more modular and compact coaxial circuit architecture for bosonic qubits with reproducibly high coherence.

title: Atomically dispersed Iridium on Mo2C as an efficient and stable alkaline hydrogen oxidation reaction catalyst
summary_zh: 报道原子分散的Ir在Mo2C上的催化剂，高效稳定地催化碱性氢氧化反应。IrSA-Mo2C/C具有高活性，稳定性好，理论计算表明其活性归因于Mo2C基底的独特性。
summary_en: Reports an atomically dispersed Ir on Mo2C catalyst for efficient and stable alkaline hydrogen oxidation reaction. IrSA-Mo2C/C exhibits high activity and stability, with theoretical calculations suggesting the unique Mo2C substrate as the source of its activity.
insights: 创新点：发现原子分散的Ir在Mo2C上的催化剂，高效催化碱性氢氧化反应。
方法亮点：通过理论计算揭示Mo2C基底对催化剂活性的贡献。
关键发现：IrSA-Mo2C/C催化剂具有高活性和稳定性。
insights_en: Novelty: Discovers an atomically dispersed Ir on Mo2C catalyst for efficient alkaline hydrogen oxidation reaction catalysis.
Method highlight: Reveals the contribution of the unique Mo2C substrate to the catalyst activity through theoretical calculations.
Key finding: IrSA-Mo2C/C catalyst exhibits high activity and stability.
abstract: Hydroxide exchange membrane fuel cells (HEMFCs) have the advantages of using cost-effective materials, but hindered by the sluggish anodic hydrogen oxidation reaction (HOR) kinetics. Here, we report an atomically dispersed Ir on Mo<sub>2</sub>C nanoparticles supported on carbon (Ir<sub>SA</sub>-Mo<sub>2</sub>C/C) as highly active and stable HOR catalysts. The specific exchange current density of Ir<sub>SA</sub>-Mo<sub>2</sub>C/C is 4.1 mA cm<sup>-2</sup><sub>ECSA</sub>, which is 10 times that of Ir/C. Negligible decay is observed after 30,000-cycle accelerated stability test. Theoretical calculations suggest the high HOR activity is attributed to the unique Mo<sub>2</sub>C substrate, which makes the Ir sites with optimized H binding and also provides enhanced OH binding sites. By using a low loading (0.05 mg<sub>Ir</sub> cm<sup>-2</sup>) of Ir<sub>SA</sub>-Mo<sub>2</sub>C/C as anode, the fabricated HEMFC can deliver a high peak power density of 1.64 W cm<sup>-2</sup>. This work illustrates that atomically dispersed precious metal on carbides may be a promising strategy for high performance HEMFCs.

title: Domain wall magnetic tunnel junction-based artificial synapses and neurons for all-spin neuromorphic hardware
summary_zh: 报道基于磁隧道结的人工突触和神经元，实现全自旋神经形态硬件。利用自旋轨道扭矩和界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用，实现可编程多状态突触设备，具有高可靠性。
summary_en: Reports artificial synapses and neurons based on magnetic tunnel junctions for all-spin neuromorphic hardware. Utilizes spin-orbit torque and interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction to achieve a programmable multi-state synaptic device with high reliability.
insights: 创新点：提出基于磁隧道结的人工突触和神经元。
方法亮点：利用自旋轨道扭矩和界面Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相互作用实现高可靠性突触设备。
关键发现：实现全自旋神经形态硬件中的可编程多状态突触。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposes artificial synapses and neurons based on magnetic tunnel junctions.
Method highlight: Achieves high-reliability synaptic devices using spin-orbit torque and interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction.
Key finding: Implements programmable multi-state synapses in all-spin neuromorphic hardware.
abstract: We report a breakthrough in the hardware implementation of energy-efficient all-spin synapse and neuron devices for highly scalable integrated neuromorphic circuits. Our work demonstrates the successful execution of all-spin synapse and activation function generator using domain wall-magnetic tunnel junctions. By harnessing the synergistic effects of spin-orbit torque and interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction in selectively etched spin-orbit coupling layers, we achieve a programmable multi-state synaptic device with high reliability. Our first-principles calculations confirm that the reduced atomic distance between 5d and 3d atoms enhances Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, leading to stable domain wall pinning. Our experimental results, supported by visualizing energy landscapes and theoretical simulations, validate the proposed mechanism. Furthermore, we demonstrate a spin-neuron with a sigmoidal activation function, enabling high operation frequency up to 20 MHz and low energy consumption of 508 fJ/operation. A neuron circuit design with a compact sigmoidal cell area and low power consumption is also presented, along with corroborated experimental implementation. Our findings highlight the great potential of domain wall-magnetic tunnel junctions in the development of all-spin neuromorphic computing hardware, offering exciting possibilities for energy-efficient and scalable neural network architectures.

title: Transparent radiative cooling cover window for flexible and foldable electronic displays
summary_zh: 设计透明辐射冷却覆盖窗口，用于柔性折叠电子显示屏。通过合理设计和合成，实现50微米厚度的透明辐射冷却超材料，提高柔性电子设备的散热能力。
summary_en: Designs a transparent radiative cooling cover window for flexible and foldable electronic displays. Achieves a 50-micron-thick transparent radiative cooling metamaterial through rational design and synthesis, enhancing the cooling capacity of flexible electronic devices.
insights: 创新点：设计透明辐射冷却覆盖窗口，提高柔性电子设备散热。
方法亮点：通过合理设计和合成实现超材料，优化散热性能。
关键发现：实现50微米厚度的透明辐射冷却超材料。
insights_en: Novelty: Designs a transparent radiative cooling cover window to enhance the cooling of flexible electronic devices.
Method highlight: Achieves the metamaterial through rational design and synthesis, optimizing the cooling performance.
Key finding: Implements a 50-micron-thick transparent radiative cooling metamaterial.
abstract: Transparent radiative cooling holds the promise to efficiently manage thermal conditions in various electronic devices without additional energy consumption. Radiative cooling cover windows designed for foldable and flexible displays could enhance cooling capacities in the ubiquitous deployment of flexible electronics in outdoor environments. However, previous demonstrations have not met the optical, mechanical, and moisture-impermeable criteria for such cover windows. Herein, we report transparent radiative cooling metamaterials with a thickness of 50 microns as a cover window of foldable and flexible displays by rational design and synthesis of embedding optically-modulating microstructures in clear polyimide. The resulting outcome not only includes excellent light emission in the atmospheric window under the secured optical transparency but also provides enhanced mechanical and moisture-impermeable properties to surpass the demands of target applications. Our metamaterials not only substantially mitigate the temperature rise in heat-generating devices exposed to solar irradiance but also enhance the thermal management of devices in dark conditions. The light output performance of light-emitting diodes in displays on which the metamaterials are deployed is greatly enhanced by suppressing the performance deterioration associated with thermalization.

title: Effect of crystal facets in plasmonic catalysis
summary_zh: 研究晶面在等离子体催化中的作用。不同形状的Au纳米粒子提高CO还原效率。
summary_en: Study the role of crystal facets in plasmonic catalysis. Different shapes of Au nanoparticles improve CO reduction efficiency.
insights: 晶面影响等离子体催化
Au纳米粒子形状影响效率
提高CO还原效率
insights_en: Crystal facets affect plasmonic catalysis
Shape of Au nanoparticles impacts efficiency
Improved CO reduction efficiency
abstract: While the role of crystal facets is well known in traditional heterogeneous catalysis, this effect has not yet been thoroughly studied in plasmon-assisted catalysis, where attention has primarily focused on plasmon-derived mechanisms. Here, we investigate plasmon-assisted electrocatalytic CO<sub>2</sub> reduction using different shapes of plasmonic Au nanoparticles - nanocube (NC), rhombic dodecahedron (RD), and octahedron (OC) - exposing {100}, {110}, and {111} facets, respectively. Upon plasmon excitation, Au OCs doubled CO Faradaic efficiency (FE<sub>CO</sub>) and tripled CO partial current density (j<sub>CO</sub>) compared to a dark condition, with NCs also improving under illumination. In contrast, Au RDs maintained consistent performance irrespective of light exposure, suggesting minimal influence of light on the reaction. Temperature experiments ruled out heat as the main factor to explain such differences. Atomistic simulations and electromagnetic modeling revealed higher hot carrier abundance and electric field enhancement on Au OCs and NCs than RDs. These effects now dominate the reaction landscape over the crystal facets, thus shifting the reaction sites when comparing dark and plasmon-activated processes. Plasmon-assisted H<sub>2</sub> evolution reaction experiments also support these findings. The dominance of low-coordinated sites over facets in plasmonic catalysis suggests key insights for designing efficient photocatalysts for energy conversion and carbon neutralization.

title: Polyoxometalate-based plasmonic electron sponge membrane for nanofluidic osmotic energy conversion
summary_zh: 设计基于多酸基等离子体电子海绵膜。光照射下，提高渗透能转换效率。
summary_en: Design a polyoxometalate-based plasmonic electron sponge membrane for nanofluidic osmotic energy conversion. Under light irradiation, improve osmotic energy conversion efficiency.
insights: 多酸基等离子体电子海绵膜设计
光照射提高转换效率
提高渗透能转换效率
insights_en: Design of polyoxometalate-based plasmonic electron sponge membrane
Light irradiation improves conversion efficiency
Enhanced osmotic energy conversion efficiency
abstract: Nanofluidic membranes have demonstrated great potential in harvesting osmotic energy. However, the output power densities are usually hampered by insufficient membrane permselectivity. Herein, we design a polyoxometalates (POMs)-based nanofluidic plasmonic electron sponge membrane (PESM) for highly efficient osmotic energy conversion. Under light irradiation, hot electrons are generated on Au NPs surface and then transferred and stored in POMs electron sponges, while hot holes are consumed by water. The stored hot electrons in POMs increase the charge density and hydrophilicity of PESM, resulting in significantly improved permselectivity for high-performance osmotic energy conversion. In addition, the unique ionic current rectification (ICR) property of the prepared nanofluidic PESM inhibits ion concentration polarization effectively, which could further improve its permselectivity. Under light with 500-fold NaCl gradient, the maximum output power density of the prepared PESM reaches 70.4 W m<sup>-2</sup>, which is further enhanced even to 102.1 W m<sup>-2</sup> by changing the ligand to P<sub>5</sub>W<sub>30</sub>. This work highlights the crucial roles of plasmonic electron sponge for tailoring the surface charge, modulating ion transport dynamics, and improving the performance of nanofluidic osmotic energy conversion.

title: Physiological temperature drives TRPM4 ligand recognition and gating
summary_zh: 研究生理温度对TRPM4结构功能的影响，发现温度依赖性Ca2+结合位点驱动'温暖'构象。
summary_en: This study investigates the impact of physiological temperature on the structure and function of TRPM4, finding a temperature-dependent Ca2+-binding site that drives a 'warm' conformation.
insights: 创新点：生理温度影响TRPM4结构功能
方法亮点：单粒子冷冻电镜研究
关键发现：温度依赖性Ca2+结合位点驱动构象变化
insights_en: Novelty: Physiological temperature affects TRPM4 structure and function
Method highlight: Single-particle cryo-electron microscopy study
Key finding: Temperature-dependent Ca2+-binding site drives conformational changes
abstract: Temperature profoundly affects macromolecular function, particularly in proteins with temperature sensitivity<sup>1,2</sup>. However, its impact is often overlooked in biophysical studies that are typically performed at non-physiological temperatures, potentially leading to inaccurate mechanistic and pharmacological insights. Here we demonstrate temperature-dependent changes in the structure and function of TRPM4, a temperature-sensitive Ca<sup>2+</sup>-activated ion channel<sup>3-7</sup>. By studying TRPM4 prepared at physiological temperature using single-particle cryo-electron microscopy, we identified a 'warm' conformation that is distinct from those observed at lower temperatures. This conformation is driven by a temperature-dependent Ca<sup>2+</sup>-binding site in the intracellular domain, and is essential for TRPM4 function in physiological contexts. We demonstrated that ligands, exemplified by decavanadate (a positive modulator)<sup>8</sup> and ATP (an inhibitor)<sup>9</sup>, bind to different locations of TRPM4 at physiological temperatures than at lower temperatures<sup>10,11</sup>, and that these sites have bona fide functional relevance. We elucidated the TRPM4 gating mechanism by capturing structural snapshots of its different functional states at physiological temperatures, revealing the channel opening that is not observed at lower temperatures. Our study provides an example of temperature-dependent ligand recognition and modulation of an ion channel, underscoring the importance of studying macromolecules at physiological temperatures. It also provides a potential molecular framework for deciphering how thermosensitive TRPM channels perceive temperature changes.

title: Public engagement for inclusive and sustainable governance of climate interventions
summary_zh: 研究公众参与气候干预治理的偏好，强调响应本地政治文化和环境，关注全球问题。
summary_en: This study explores public preferences for climate intervention governance, emphasizing responsiveness to local political cultures and socio-technical environments, and attention to global issues.
insights: 创新点：公众参与气候治理的偏好研究
方法亮点：多国焦点小组研究
关键发现：本地文化和全球问题需平衡
insights_en: Novelty: Public preference study for climate governance
Method highlight: Multi-country focus group study
Key finding: Balancing local culture and global issues is necessary
abstract: The need for public engagement is increasingly evident as discussions intensify around emerging methods for carbon dioxide removal and controversial proposals around solar geoengineering. Based on 44 focus groups in 22 countries across the Global North and Global South (N = 323 participants), this article traces public preferences for a variety of bottom-up and top-down engagement practices ranging from information recipient to broad decision authority. Here, we show that engagement practices need to be responsive to local political cultures and socio-technical environments, while attending to the global dimensions and interconnectedness of the issues at stake. Establishing public engagement as a cornerstone of inclusive and sustainable governance of climate-intervention technologies requires (i) recognizing the diversity of forms and intensities of engaging, (ii) considering national contexts and modes of engagement, (iii) tailoring to technological idiosyncrasies, (iv) adopting power-sensitive practices, (v) accounting for publics' prior experience, (vi) establishing trust and procedural legitimacy and (vii) engaging with tensions and value disagreements.

title: Explainable chemical artificial intelligence from accurate machine learning of real-space chemical descriptors
summary_zh: 开发SchNet4AIM架构，结合局部和两体描述符，实现可解释的化学人工智能。
summary_en: This paper develops the SchNet4AIM architecture, combining local and two-body descriptors, to achieve explainable chemical artificial intelligence.
insights: 创新点：SchNet4AIM架构实现可解释化学AI
方法亮点：结合局部和两体描述符
关键发现：提高预测准确性和可解释性
insights_en: Novelty: SchNet4AIM architecture for explainable chemical AI
Method highlight: Combination of local and two-body descriptors
Key finding: Improved prediction accuracy and interpretability
abstract: Machine-learned computational chemistry has led to a paradoxical situation in which molecular properties can be accurately predicted, but they are difficult to interpret. Explainable AI (XAI) tools can be used to analyze complex models, but they are highly dependent on the AI technique and the origin of the reference data. Alternatively, interpretable real-space tools can be employed directly, but they are often expensive to compute. To address this dilemma between explainability and accuracy, we developed SchNet4AIM, a SchNet-based architecture capable of dealing with local one-body (atomic) and two-body (interatomic) descriptors. The performance of SchNet4AIM is tested by predicting a wide collection of real-space quantities ranging from atomic charges and delocalization indices to pairwise interaction energies. The accuracy and speed of SchNet4AIM breaks the bottleneck that has prevented the use of real-space chemical descriptors in complex systems. We show that the group delocalization indices, arising from our physically rigorous atomistic predictions, provide reliable indicators of supramolecular binding events, thus contributing to the development of Explainable Chemical Artificial Intelligence (XCAI) models.

title: Whole-soil warming leads to substantial soil carbon emission in an alpine grassland
summary_zh: 全土壤增温实验显示，高山草地土壤碳排放显著增加。
summary_en: Whole-soil warming experiments show substantial soil carbon emission increases in an alpine grassland.
insights: 创新点：全土壤增温影响土壤碳排放
方法亮点：长期实验研究
关键发现：增温显著增加碳排放
insights_en: Novelty: Whole-soil warming affects soil carbon emission
Method highlight: Long-term experimental study
Key finding: Warming significantly increases carbon emission
abstract: The sensitivity of soil organic carbon (SOC) decomposition in seasonally frozen soils, such as alpine ecosystems, to climate warming is a major uncertainty in global carbon cycling. Here we measure soil CO<sub>2</sub> emission during four years (2018-2021) from the whole-soil warming experiment (4 °C for the top 1 m) in an alpine grassland ecosystem. We find that whole-soil warming stimulates total and SOC-derived CO<sub>2</sub> efflux by 26% and 37%, respectively, but has a minor effect on root-derived CO<sub>2</sub> efflux. Moreover, experimental warming only promotes total soil CO<sub>2</sub> efflux by 7-8% on average in the meta-analysis across all grasslands or alpine grasslands globally (none of these experiments were whole-soil warming). We show that whole-soil warming has a much stronger effect on soil carbon emission in the alpine grassland ecosystem than what was reported in previous warming experiments, most of which only heat surface soils.

title: Biological fermentation pilot-scale systems and evaluation for commercial viability towards sustainable biohydrogen production
summary_zh: 建立生物发酵中试系统，评估可持续生物制氢的商业可行性。
summary_en: Establish biological fermentation pilot-scale systems to evaluate the commercial viability of sustainable biohydrogen production.
insights: 创新点：生物发酵中试系统评估制氢可行性
方法亮点：多方面评估可持续性
关键发现：中试系统为商业应用提供参考
insights_en: Novelty: Biological fermentation pilot-scale systems for hydrogen production feasibility evaluation
Method highlight: Comprehensive evaluation of sustainability
Key finding: Pilot-scale systems provide reference for commercial application
abstract: Featuring high caloric value, clean-burning, and renewability, hydrogen is a fuel believed to be able to change energy structure worldwide. Biohydrogen production technologies effectively utilize waste biomass resources and produce high-purity hydrogen. Improvements have been made in the biohydrogen production process in recent years. However, there is a lack of operational data and sustainability analysis from pilot plants to provide a reference for commercial operations. In this report, based on spectrum coupling, thermal effect, and multiphase flow properties of hydrogen production, continuous pilot-scale biohydrogen production systems (dark and photo-fermentation) are established as a research subject. Then, pilot-scale hydrogen production systems are assessed in terms of sustainability. The system being evaluated, consumes 171,530 MJ of energy and emits 9.37 t of CO<sub>2</sub> eq when producing 1 t H<sub>2</sub>, and has a payback period of 6.86 years. Our analysis also suggests future pathways towards effective biohydrogen production technology development and real-world implementation.

title: Demixing is a default process for biological condensates formed via phase separation
summary_zh: 研究证明兴奋性和抑制性突触后密度通过相分离自发分离。发现抑制性突触后密度形成迫使gephyrin离开兴奋性突触后密度。
summary_en: This study demonstrates that excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic densities (e/iPSDs) spontaneously segregate through phase separation. Found that formation of iPSD condensates forces gephyrin out of ePSD condensates.
insights: 创新点：证明兴奋性和抑制性突触后密度通过相分离自发分离。
方法亮点：采用体外和细胞生化重建。
关键发现：抑制性突触后密度形成迫使gephyrin离开兴奋性突触后密度。
insights_en: Novelty: Demonstrated spontaneous segregation of e/iPSDs through phase separation.
Method highlight: Employed biochemical reconstitutions in vitro and in cells.
Key finding: Formation of iPSD condensates forces gephyrin out of ePSD condensates.
abstract: Excitatory and inhibitory synapses do not overlap even when formed on one submicron-sized dendritic protrusion. How excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic cytomatrices or densities (e/iPSDs) are segregated is not understood. Broadly, why membraneless organelles are naturally segregated in cellular subcompartments is unclear. Using biochemical reconstitutions in vitro and in cells, we demonstrate that ePSDs and iPSDs spontaneously segregate into distinct condensed molecular assemblies through phase separation. Tagging iPSD scaffold gephyrin with a PSD-95 intrabody (dissociation constant ~4 nM) leads to mistargeting of gephyrin to ePSD condensates. Unexpectedly, formation of iPSD condensates forces the intrabody-tagged gephyrin out of ePSD condensates. Thus, instead of diffusion-governed spontaneous mixing, demixing is a default process for biomolecules in condensates. Phase separation can generate biomolecular compartmentalization specificities that cannot occur in dilute solutions.

title: Octopi: Object Property Reasoning with Large Tactile-Language Models
summary_zh: 研究结合触觉感知与语言，实现机器人通过交互获取物理属性并进行常识推理。提出新数据集PhysiCLeAR。
summary_en: Investigates combining tactile perception with language for robots to obtain physical properties through interaction and apply common-sense reasoning. Introduces a new dataset PhysiCLeAR.
insights: 创新点：触觉与语言结合进行物理推理
方法亮点：新数据集PhysiCLeAR
关键发现：实现机器人常识推理
insights_en: Novelty: Tactile and language integration for physical reasoning
Method highlight: New dataset PhysiCLeAR
Key finding: Robot common-sense reasoning
abstract: Physical reasoning is important for effective robot manipulation. Recent work has investigated both vision and language modalities for physical reasoning; vision can reveal information about objects in the environment and language serves as an abstraction and communication medium for additional context. Although these works have demonstrated success on a variety of physical reasoning tasks, they are limited to physical properties that can be inferred from visual or language inputs. In this work, we investigate combining tactile perception with language, which enables embodied systems to obtain physical properties through interaction and apply commonsense reasoning. We contribute a new dataset PhysiCLeAR, which comprises both physical/property reasoning tasks and annotated tactile videos obtained using a GelSight tactile sensor. We then introduce Octopi, a system that leverages both tactile representation learning and large vision-language models to predict and reason about tactile inputs with minimal language fine-tuning. Our evaluations on PhysiCLeAR show that Octopi is able to effectively use intermediate physical property predictions to improve its performance on various tactile-related tasks. PhysiCLeAR and Octopi are available at https://github.com/clear-nus/octopi.

title: Two telomere-to-telomere gapless genomes reveal insights into Capsicum evolution and capsaicinoid biosynthesis
summary_zh: 通过T2T基因组研究辣椒进化与辣椒素生物合成机制。
summary_en: Two T2T gapless genomes are used to study the evolution and capsaicinoid biosynthesis mechanism of chili peppers.
insights: 创新点：T2T基因组揭示辣椒进化
方法亮点：分析CRM逆转录转座子影响
关键发现：辣椒素生物合成基因调控
insights_en: Novelty: T2T genomes reveal chili pepper evolution
Method highlight: Analyzing the impact of CRM retrotransposons
Key finding: Regulation of capsaicinoid biosynthesis genes
abstract: Chili pepper (Capsicum) is known for its unique fruit pungency due to the presence of capsaicinoids. The evolutionary history of capsaicinoid biosynthesis and the mechanism of their tissue specificity remain obscure due to the lack of high-quality Capsicum genomes. Here, we report two telomere-to-telomere (T2T) gap-free genomes of C. annuum and its wild nonpungent relative C. rhomboideum to investigate the evolution of fruit pungency in chili peppers. We precisely delineate Capsicum centromeres, which lack high-copy tandem repeats but are extensively invaded by CRM retrotransposons. Through phylogenomic analyses, we estimate the evolutionary timing of capsaicinoid biosynthesis. We reveal disrupted coding and regulatory regions of key biosynthesis genes in nonpungent species. We also find conserved placenta-specific accessible chromatin regions, which likely allow for tissue-specific biosynthetic gene coregulation and capsaicinoid accumulation. These T2T genomic resources will accelerate chili pepper genetic improvement and help to understand Capsicum genome evolution.

title: A filtering reconfigurable intelligent surface for interference-free wireless communications
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种滤波可重构智能表面，具有锐利的频率选择性和2位相移特性。它允许窄带信号传输，同时拒绝带外信号，并能够灵活地控制信号传播。
summary_en: This paper proposes a filtering reconfigurable intelligent surface with sharp frequency selectivity and 2-bit phase-shifting properties. It allows signals in a narrow bandwidth to transmit but rejects out-of-band signals, enabling flexible manipulations of signal propagation.
insights: 创新点：提出滤波可重构智能表面，具有锐利的频率选择性
方法亮点：实现窄带信号传输和带外信号拒绝
关键发现：灵活控制信号传播
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a filtering RIS with sharp frequency selectivity
Method highlight: Achieving narrowband signal transmission and rejection of out-of-band signals
Key finding: Flexible manipulation of signal propagation
abstract: The powerful capability of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RISs) in tailoring electromagnetic waves and fields has put them under the spotlight in wireless communications. However, the current designs are criticized due to their poor frequency selectivity, which hinders their applications in real-world scenarios where the spectrum is becoming increasingly congested. Here we propose a filtering RIS to feature sharp frequency-selecting and 2-bit phase-shifting properties. It permits the signals in a narrow bandwidth to transmit but rejects the out-of-band ones; meanwhile, the phase of the transmitted signals can be digitally controlled, enabling flexible manipulations of signal propagations. A prototype is designed, fabricated, and measured, and its high quality factor and phase-shifting characteristics are validated by scattering parameters and beam-steering phenomena. Further, we conduct a wireless communication experiment to illustrate the intriguing functions of the RIS. The filtering behavior enables the RIS to perform wireless signal manipulations with anti-interference ability, thus showing big potential to advance the development of next-generation wireless communications.

title: The odd-number cyclo[13]carbon and its dimer, cyclo[26]carbon
summary_zh: 本研究通过表面合成方法成功制备了奇数碳环化合物 cyclo[13]carbon，并揭示了其独特的分子结构和性质。
summary_en: This study successfully synthesized the odd-numbered carbon ring compound cyclo[13]carbon by surface synthesis and elucidated its unique molecular structure and properties.
insights: 创新点：首次合成奇数碳环化合物 cyclo[13]carbon
方法亮点：利用扫描探针显微镜进行表面合成
关键发现：C<sub>13</sub> 具有独特的开放壳构型和扭曲几何形状
insights_en: Novelty: First synthesis of the odd-numbered carbon ring compound cyclo[13]carbon
Method highlight: Surface synthesis using a scanning probe microscope
Key finding: C<sub>13</sub> exhibits a unique open-shell configuration and kinked geometry
abstract: Molecular rings of N carbon atoms (cyclo[N]carbons, or CN) are excellent benchmarking systems for testing quantum chemical theoretical methods and valuable precursors to other carbon-rich materials. Odd-N cyclocarbons, which have been elusive to date, are predicted to be even less stable than even-N cyclocarbons. We report the on-surface synthesis of cyclo[13]carbon, C13, by manipulation of decachlorofluorene with a scanning probe microscope tip. We elucidated the properties of C13 by experiment and theoretical modeling. C13 adopts an open-shell configuration with a triplet ground state and a kinked geometry, which shows different extents of distortion and carbene localization depending on the molecular environment. Moreover, we prepared and characterized the C13 dimer, cyclo[26]carbon, demonstrating the potential of cyclocarbons and their precursors as building blocks for carbon allotropes.

title: The first two blastomeres contribute unequally to the human embryo
summary_zh: 本研究通过活体成像和细胞标记技术发现，人类胚胎早期阶段，第一和第二个分裂球对胚胎的贡献不均等。
summary_en: This study finds through live imaging and non-invasive cell labeling that the first and second blastomeres contribute unequally to the human embryo in the early stage.
insights: 创新点：揭示人类胚胎早期分裂球贡献不均等的现象
方法亮点：结合活体成像和细胞标记技术进行追踪
关键发现：第一分裂球对胚胎贡献较大
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the unequal contribution of blastomeres in early human embryo development
Method highlight: Combining live imaging and non-invasive cell labeling for tracing
Key finding: The first blastomere contributes more significantly to the embryo
abstract: Retrospective lineage reconstruction of humans predicts that dramatic clonal imbalances in the body can be traced to the 2-cell stage embryo. However, whether and how such clonal asymmetries arise in the embryo is unclear. Here, we performed prospective lineage tracing of human embryos using live imaging, non-invasive cell labeling, and computational predictions to determine the contribution of each 2-cell stage blastomere to the epiblast (body), hypoblast (yolk sac), and trophectoderm (placenta). We show that the majority of epiblast cells originate from only one blastomere of the 2-cell stage embryo. We observe that only one to three cells become internalized at the 8-to-16-cell stage transition. Moreover, these internalized cells are more frequently derived from the first cell to divide at the 2-cell stage. We propose that cell division dynamics and a cell internalization bottleneck in the early embryo establish asymmetry in the clonal composition of the future human body.

title: Natural proteome diversity links aneuploidy tolerance to protein turnover
summary_zh: 研究揭示自然蛋白质组多样性将非整倍体耐受性与蛋白质周转联系起来。方法上，通过整合基因组、转录组和蛋白质组数据进行分析。结果表明，自然和实验室产生的非整倍体在蛋白质组上存在差异。
summary_en: This study reveals that natural proteome diversity links aneuploidy tolerance to protein turnover. The method involves integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data for analysis. Results indicate that natural and lab-generated aneuploids differ specifically in the proteome.
insights: 创新点：发现非整倍体耐受性与蛋白质周转的关系
方法亮点：整合多组学数据进行分析
关键发现：自然和实验室非整倍体蛋白质组差异
insights_en: Novelty: Discovery of the relationship between aneuploidy tolerance and protein turnover
Method highlight: Integrating multi-omics data for analysis
Key finding: Differences in proteomes between natural and lab-generated aneuploids
abstract: Accessing the natural genetic diversity of species unveils hidden genetic traits, clarifies gene functions and allows the generalizability of laboratory findings to be assessed. One notable discovery made in natural isolates of Saccharomyces cerevisiae is that aneuploidy-an imbalance in chromosome copy numbers-is frequent<sup>1,2</sup> (around 20%), which seems to contradict the substantial fitness costs and transient nature of aneuploidy when it is engineered in the laboratory<sup>3-5</sup>. Here we generate a proteomic resource and merge it with genomic<sup>1</sup> and transcriptomic<sup>6</sup> data for 796 euploid and aneuploid natural isolates. We find that natural and lab-generated aneuploids differ specifically at the proteome. In lab-generated aneuploids, some proteins-especially subunits of protein complexes-show reduced expression, but the overall protein levels correspond to the aneuploid gene dosage. By contrast, in natural isolates, more than 70% of proteins encoded on aneuploid chromosomes are dosage compensated, and average protein levels are shifted towards the euploid state chromosome-wide. At the molecular level, we detect an induction of structural components of the proteasome, increased levels of ubiquitination, and reveal an interdependency of protein turnover rates and attenuation. Our study thus highlights the role of protein turnover in mediating aneuploidy tolerance, and shows the utility of exploiting the natural diversity of species to attain generalizable molecular insights into complex biological processes.

title: Nested non-covalent interactions expand the functions of supramolecular polymer networks
summary_zh: 研究提出利用嵌套非共价相互作用扩展超分子聚合物网络的功能。方法上，通过引入并行非共价相互作用来控制材料功能。结果表明，这种策略显著增强了材料的机械响应和功能性。
summary_en: This study proposes using nested non-covalent interactions to expand the functions of supramolecular polymer networks. The method involves introducing parallel non-covalent interactions to control material functions. Results indicate that this strategy significantly enhances the mechanical responses and functionality of the materials.
insights: 创新点：提出嵌套非共价相互作用的概念
方法亮点：引入并行非共价相互作用
关键发现：显著增强材料功能
insights_en: Novelty: Proposal of the concept of nested non-covalent interactions
Method highlight: Introduction of parallel non-covalent interactions
Key finding: Significant enhancement of material functionality
abstract: Supramolecular polymer networks contain non-covalent cross-links that enable access to broadly tunable mechanical properties and stimuli-responsive behaviors; the incorporation of multiple unique non-covalent cross-links within such materials further expands their mechanical responses and functionality. To date, however, the design of such materials has been accomplished through discrete combinations of distinct interaction types in series, limiting materials design logic. Here we introduce the concept of leveraging "nested" supramolecular crosslinks, wherein two distinct types of non-covalent interactions exist in parallel, to control bulk material functions. To demonstrate this concept, we use polymer-linked Pd<sub>2</sub>L<sub>4</sub> metal-organic cage (polyMOC) gels that form hollow metal-organic cage junctions through metal-ligand coordination and can exhibit well-defined host-guest binding within their cavity. In these "nested" supramolecular network junctions, the thermodynamics of host-guest interactions within the junctions affect the metal-ligand interactions that form those junctions, ultimately translating to substantial guest-dependent changes in bulk material properties that could not be achieved in traditional supramolecular networks with multiple interactions in series.

title: Arresting failure propagation in buildings through collapse isolation
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种通过隔离坍塌来阻止建筑结构失效传播的设计方法。该方法通过改善建筑组件间的连接性，防止坍塌元素拉下其他部分。
summary_en: This paper presents a design approach to arrest failure propagation in building structures through collapse isolation. The method improves connectivity between building components to prevent collapse elements from pulling down other parts.
insights: 创新点：隔离坍塌阻止失效传播
方法亮点：改善建筑组件连接性
关键发现：防止坍塌元素拉下其他部分
insights_en: Novelty: Isolation collapse to stop failure propagation
Method highlight: Improving connectivity between building components
Key finding: Preventing collapse elements from pulling down other parts
abstract: Several catastrophic building collapses<sup>1-5</sup> occur because of the propagation of local-initial failures<sup>6,7</sup>. Current design methods attempt to completely prevent collapse after initial failures by improving connectivity between building components. These measures ensure that the loads supported by the failed components are redistributed to the rest of the structural system<sup>8,9</sup>. However, increased connectivity can contribute to collapsing elements pulling down parts of a building that would otherwise be unaffected<sup>10</sup>. This risk is particularly important when large initial failures occur, as tends to be the case in the most disastrous collapses<sup>6</sup>. Here we present an original design approach to arrest collapse propagation after major initial failures. When a collapse initiates, the approach ensures that specific elements fail before the failure of the most critical components for global stability. The structural system thus separates into different parts and isolates collapse when its propagation would otherwise be inevitable. The effectiveness of the approach is proved through unique experimental tests on a purposely built full-scale building. We also demonstrate that large initial failures would lead to total collapse of the test building if increased connectivity was implemented as recommended by present guidelines. Our proposed approach enables incorporating a last line of defence for more resilient buildings.

title: Modulate stress distribution with bio-inspired irregular architected materials towards optimal tissue support
summary_zh: 本文通过生物启发的不规则结构材料调节应力分布，以实现最佳组织支持。研究发现，这些材料具有精确的空间变性和非周期性。
summary_en: This paper modulates stress distribution with bio-inspired irregular architected materials for optimal tissue support. It is found that these materials exhibit precise spatial variability and aperiodicity.
insights: 创新点：生物启发的不规则结构材料调节应力分布
方法亮点：实现精确的空间变性和非周期性
关键发现：材料具有精确的空间变性和非周期性
insights_en: Novelty: Stress distribution modulation with bio-inspired irregular architected materials
Method highlight: Achieving precise spatial variability and aperiodicity
Key finding: Materials exhibit precise spatial variability and aperiodicity
abstract: Natural materials typically exhibit irregular and non-periodic architectures, endowing them with compelling functionalities such as body protection, camouflage, and mechanical stress modulation. Among these functionalities, mechanical stress modulation is crucial for homeostasis regulation and tissue remodeling. Here, we uncover the relationship between stress modulation functionality and the irregularity of bio-inspired architected materials by a generative computational framework. This framework optimizes the spatial distribution of a limited set of basic building blocks and uses these blocks to assemble irregular materials with heterogeneous, disordered microstructures. Despite being irregular and non-periodic, the assembled materials display spatially varying properties that precisely modulate stress distribution towards target values in various control regions and load cases, echoing the robust stress modulation capability of natural materials. The performance of the generated irregular architected materials is experimentally validated with 3D printed physical samples - a good agreement with target stress distribution is observed. Owing to its capability to redirect loads while keeping a proper amount of stress to stimulate bone repair, we demonstrate the potential application of the stress-programmable architected materials as support in orthopedic femur restoration.

title: Memristor-based adaptive neuromorphic perception in unstructured environments
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种基于忆阻器的自适应神经形态感知方法，用于无结构环境中的导航。该方法在物体抓取和自动驾驶中表现出良好的适应性。
summary_en: This paper presents a memristor-based adaptive neuromorphic perception method for navigation in unstructured environments. The method demonstrates good adaptability in object grasping and autonomous driving.
insights: 创新点：基于忆阻器的自适应神经形态感知
方法亮点：适用于无结构环境
关键发现：在物体抓取和自动驾驶中表现出良好的适应性
insights_en: Novelty: Memristor-based adaptive neuromorphic perception
Method highlight: Applicability in unstructured environments
Key finding: Good adaptability in object grasping and autonomous driving
abstract: Efficient operation of control systems in robotics or autonomous driving targeting real-world navigation scenarios requires perception methods that allow them to understand and adapt to unstructured environments with good accuracy, adaptation, and generality, similar to humans. To address this need, we present a memristor-based differential neuromorphic computing, perceptual signal processing, and online adaptation method providing neuromorphic style adaptation to external sensory stimuli. The adaptation ability and generality of this method are confirmed in two application scenarios: object grasping and autonomous driving. In the former, a robot hand realizes safe and stable grasping through fast ( ~ 1 ms) adaptation based on the tactile object features with a single memristor. In the latter, decision-making information of 10 unstructured environments in autonomous driving is extracted with an accuracy of 94% with a 40×25 memristor array. By mimicking human low-level perception mechanisms, the electronic neuromorphic circuit-based method achieves real-time adaptation and high-level reactions to unstructured environments.

title: Evidence for multiferroicity in single-layer CuCrSe2
summary_zh: 本文报道了单层CuCrSe2材料在高温下的多铁性。该材料在室温下具有铁电性，在120 K下具有铁磁性，其铁磁性耦合由铁电性引起的Cr原子轨道位移增强。
summary_en: This paper reports high-temperature multiferroicity in single-layer CuCrSe2, which exhibits ferroelectricity at room temperature and ferromagnetism at 120 K, with the ferromagnetic coupling enhanced by the ferroelectricity-induced orbital shift of Cr atoms.
insights: 创新点：单层CuCrSe2材料的高温多铁性
方法亮点：通过Cr原子轨道位移研究铁磁性耦合
关键发现：铁电性增强铁磁性耦合
insights_en: Novelty: High-temperature multiferroicity in single-layer CuCrSe2
Method highlight: Study of ferromagnetic coupling via Cr atom orbital shift
Key finding: Ferroelectricity enhances ferromagnetic coupling
